Name: FS - SH's Boots and Shoes Pack
Author: plurffle
Description:
After [b]a lot[/b] of stalling, I finally converted my own personal boots edit into a Fashion Sense content pack! ^_^

This pack comes with recolorable shoes/boots of slightly different lengths with extra recolorable socks included. There isn't that much in this pack and I don't think I would add much new content into it because there are already other lovely custom shoes FS packs by other users! I recommend downloading the following for more options: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23341]FS Moashy's Cute Shoes Pack[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13634]No Shoes in the house - Bare feet option for Stardew[/url].

This was originally going to be added into a new themed set I have been working on for Fashion Sense, but I ended up separating the shoes assets for users who may not want to download that upcoming pack.

The custom shoes were made for the feminine farmer base, but it [i]does[/i] work for the masculine farmer base too (it's just a little shorter on them). Although, I haven't been able to extensively test that part out.

[img]https://imgur.com/OrH6e66.png[/img]
As of version 1.0, there are 5[u][u] in the Shoes category[/u][/u].

[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2050]Link to frequently asked questions and known issues section
[/url]> One specific known issue related to my custom shoes: For some reason, they may not display correctly in the farmer sprites specifically in your skills panel (it's using the final shoe sprite that uses the downwards weapon/scythe animation). I managed to fix it for a while, but reopening the game the next few days later showed that the problem returned. So... Yeah, the bug is staying there for however long.



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
